description:
## Coverage plan

**Target:** `lib/zaq/engine/connect/grant_refresh_worker.ex`. Interpreting “93% missed 58” as **93% coverage, uncovered line 58**, not 58 missed lines. Live source confirms line 58 returns `{:snooze, 1}` when the post-contention grant lookup finds no deadline/record. No coverage artifact was available to independently confirm the percentage.

Loaded `test-coverage-planner`; inspected the requested policies, live source and tests through Serena. Planning only: no edits, tests, Git mutations, or Beadwork changes. Dirty work preserved. **Action reuse: N/A—tests only.**

### Ownership and setup

Add scenarios to **`test/zaq/engine/connect/grant_refresh_worker_test.exs`**, owned by `GrantRefreshWorkerTest`.

Reuse the existing **“perform/2 snoozes until an active refresh lease expires”** fixture pattern:

- Create an OAuth2 credential with client ID/secret.
- Issue an active legacy `mcp` org grant with access/refresh tokens.
- Persist a UUID claim and deadline `~U[2026-09-18 18:01:15Z]`.
- Use base time `~U[2026-09-18 18:00:00Z]`.
- Call `perform(%Oban.Job{args: %{"grant_id" => grant.id}}, now: clock)` directly.

Extract only this repeated arrangement into a **local helper**, keeping mutation/assertions visible.

### Concrete scenarios

| Scenario | Deterministic input/setup | Exact assertions | Worker lines |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lease cleared after contention | Clock returns base time inside the refresh transaction. Outside that transaction, its callback clears `refresh_claim` and `refresh_claim_until` before returning base time. | Result `{:snooze, 1}`; reloaded claim/deadline nil; original tokens/status unchanged. | 32–35, 39–44, 51–58 |
| Grant deleted after contention | Same clock boundary, but delete the fixture grant outside the transaction. | Result `{:snooze, 1}`; `Repo.get(Grant, id) == nil`. | Same, specifically missing-row fallback at 57–58 |
| Deadline reached during handoff | Clock returns base time inside transaction and the deadline outside; repeat with deadline plus one second. Do not mutate storage. | Both return `{:snooze, 1}`; stored deadline and tokens unchanged. | 51–56 |
| Positive-delay invariant | Bounded property: integer remaining seconds `1..120`, 15 runs; set deadline accordingly, fixed clock. | Returned snooze equals generated remaining seconds; lease unchanged. | 55–56 |

The existing `now:` function seam permits deterministic interleaving. Gate callbacks using `Repo.in_transaction?/0`, **not clock-call counts**; keep all orchestration under `test/`.

### Isolation, helpers and exclusions

Retain existing `async: false` DataCase: this module already mutates channel configuration globally. Sandbox rolls back fixtures; no additional global mutation, processes, sleeps, unboxed storage, HTTP, or Mox needed.

Existing bridge stubs cover successful/unsupported refresh. `ConnectOAuthAttemptConfig`/`ConnectOAuthAttemptHTTP` support provider tests but are unnecessary here.

A statically nil lease cannot reach line 58: refresh claims it instead. This fallback requires an intervening change. Malformed deadline types are unreachable through the Ecto schema.

**Overlap:** leave token rotation, sanitization, backoff and scheduling in `refresh_test.exs`; independent single-flight races already belong to `refresh_concurrency_test.exs`.

### Coordinator-only validation

```sh
mix q
mix test test/zaq/engine/connect/grant_refresh_worker_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect/refresh_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect/refresh_concurrency_test.exs
```

No validation was executed.

### Coordinator override

Implement owned tests only; no Mix/Git/Beadwork commands; coordinator runs q then added/edited tests --cover only.
